name: turbo-surf
description: Native-speed, browserless web crawler + MCP server for AI agents. A standalone Rust engine (turbo-dom + a V8 JS-render tier) — fetch + parse + extract + run page JS with no headless browser. This npm package is a thin launcher that spawns the native binary.

scripts.test:playwright: npm run build:addon && npm run test:shim && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test: python3 scripts/check-versions.py && bash scripts/check-single-v8.sh && python3 -B scripts/test_smoke_mcp_release.py && python3 -B scripts/test_check_coverage_floors.py && python3 -B scripts/test_coverage_shard.py && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s rust/release-deps -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s rust/release-deps/deno -p 'test_*.py' && python3 scripts/sync-third-party-notices.py --check && python3 harness/detection/verify-audio-sources.py && (cd rust && cargo test --workspace && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --check) && npm run test:playwright && npm run test:detection
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.test:detection: node --test --test-concurrency=1 harness/detection/*.test.mjs && python3 -B harness/detection/engine-155/test_async_admission_helper.py && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s harness/detection/engine-154 -p 'test_*.py'

author: miaskiewicz
